defects.summary: Prior-wave blocker 'ci/harness absent on sparse Linux worktree' is resolved: ci/redaction.py, modules.py, ledger.py, dispatcher.py all present on this full checkout and executed by both probes (T1-T4 executed=true).

Prior-wave blocker 'scripts/build-codespace-mirror.py absent' is resolved: executed as a subprocess with sandboxed HOME (T9 executed=true, no body in emitted mirror files - env values emitted as ${PLACEHOLDER}).

platform/plugin/logs.py Logger.log persists the op and event LABEL parameters unredacted (measured: body planted in op/event reaches plugin.log verbatim), while the fields channel is deny-by-default redacted ('token' -> <redacted:key-name>). Reclassified P1->P2 on this re-measure: zero production call sites pass dynamic op/event strings (grep census over platform/ and tools/ finds Logger only in tests), so the leak requires a caller to place a credential in a structural label. Fix: route op/event through redact_text before persistence.

platform/plugin/proc.py::run inherits the full parent environment into the child (T12 CONFIRMED via child-written envdump.json). Reclassified P1->P2 on this re-measure: the harness itself prints/persists nothing; the child (caller-controlled) did the persisting. Caller-side allowlist pattern exists in-estate (probe_common.allowlisted_env). Fix seam: optional env allowlist parameter on run()/launch_argv chain.

NEW measured finding: ci/harness/redaction.py has no entropy catch-all, so a bare high-entropy credential body embedded without a key= separator passes redact_text and is persisted by EventLedger.append/set_goal and HarnessDispatcher.dispatch into events.jsonl/state.json (T3/T4 CONFIRMED in both probes). platform/plugin/logs.py shows the stronger deny-by-default pattern to copy.

report.answer: Measured on the FULL Windows checkout (ci/, platform/, scripts/ all present). CONFIRMED persisted-body channels: T3 ci EventLedger (events.jsonl, state.json), T4 ci HarnessDispatcher (same ledger files), T12 plugin proc env-inheritance (child-written file). Clean for this credential shape: T1, T2, T5, T6, T7, T8, T9, T10, T11, T14. T13 PARTIAL (script guards refused sandbox; echo channels clean). Root cause: ci/harness/redaction.py lacks an entropy catch-all (bare unkeyed bodies survive); platform/plugin/logs.py shows the stronger deny-by-default pattern (fields channel protected; op/event labels not - defect D3). No real credential was read; planted value synthetic (prefix syn37_, sha256 10473c4d7f80ef021e48432ec2b504ef4f476d6aa90b4f3c5dfec25a8c2b840e, 70 bytes).
